status: Exploratory specification made after inspecting catalogue groupings and support counts, before computing this predictive comparison; not preregistered
candidate_families: Every feature record in catalogue_features.json with at least two distinct Wells identifiers; these are source groupings, not established allographs
namespace_policy: Do not replace inscription signs. Use temporary family labels only for grouping and context features. Retain all original W identifiers and all M mapping uncertainty.
input: Existing strict R/L single-line transcription subset
observation_unit: Unique artifact, literal sequence, site and object type; source row identifiers retained
leakage_control: Connected components linking the same artifact OR the same complete sequence after all candidate-family substitutions; each component belongs to one of five deterministic folds
target: Exact W variant, conditional on knowing the source family; not the family itself, language, meaning, or sound
models: family frequency with Jeffreys half-count prior
metadata context (site, object type, exact length, file-order slot) smoothed toward family frequency
immediate flanking family-normalized signs smoothed toward the metadata prediction
model_selection: No choice of best strength per family; all three reported
bootstrap: 1000 resamples of held-out connected components, fixed predictions and fixed support-selected families; aggregate uncertainty only, not per-family significance
descriptive_checks: Exact one-position substitution frames and co-occurrence of distinct family members in a text
limits: No gain is not proof of equivalence, especially with sparse contexts
Context predictability is compatible with contextual allography, scribal conventions, time or site effects, as well as distinct signs
Metadata smoothing is a predictive baseline, not complete control of confounding
Five-fold evaluation reuses this previously examined corpus; it is not an untouched decipherment test
Every M sign receives an evidence-index row, including explicit absence of a testable mapped family

background_source.access: Public repository abstract read; full paper not downloaded or method replicated

post_result_group_size_sensitivity.timing: Added after inspecting initial results and the large connected component
checks: Exclude largest component by supported-token count
post_result_group_size_sensitivity.scope: Evaluation weighting only; fixed predictions and no refitting; no choice substituted for specified headline result
